description: Estimate a number for one case, with calibrated uncertainty. Returns a median (the answer), an 80% range the true value should fall inside about 80 times in 100, the quantiles you asked for, and the probability of crossing any threshold you name. Use the median as the answer, and the range when the decision depends on how wrong it could be. Needs a `target` id from `list_targets`. The first call after an idle period can take tens of seconds.

examples.description: Past cases with their known answers, up to 16. Required (at least 8) for a target that is not in the catalogue.

state.description: The case to read, as an object of your own columns ({"airline": "Vistara", "days_left": 9}) or as plain text. Send everything you know about this one case — the model reads it as a record.

interval_levels.description: Coverage levels for ranges, e.g. [0.5, 0.8]. Default 0.8.

return_pmf.description: Count targets only: the probability of each individual value.

state.description: The case to read, as an object of your own columns ({"airline": "Vistara", "days_left": 9}) or as plain text. Send everything you know about this one case — the model reads it as a record.

target.description: A target id from list_targets, e.g. "uci_1.rings" or "kgl_flight_price_prediction.price".

thresholds.description: Numbers to test crossing. Returns P(value > t) for each — use this rather than comparing the median yourself.

name: estimate
